id.description: A stable slug from the name, such as mara-lind.

title.description: Their title as the fund's site writes it ("General Partner").

role.description: The closest role; the title keeps the exact wording.

status.description: former when they left the fund; the record stays.

groups.description: The groups the fund's team page files them under, in its words ("Investment team", "Founder Council").

bio.description: Their bio as the fund's site states it.

board_positions.description: Companies whose board the fund's site says they sit on: [[companies/<id>]].

related_investments.description: Other companies the fund's site lists against them ("related investments"): [[companies/<id>]]. Not a claim that they lead the investment.

photo.description: The chosen headshot: a link to its record in media ([[media/<id>]]).

profiles.description: Public profiles the fund's or company's own pages link to. Never searched for elsewhere.

source_paths.description: Where this came from: the web pages (https://…) or wiki paths it was read from. Evidence, not ownership.

checked_at.description: When the sources were last read for this record, in UTC.

content.description: Optional Markdown writing about this record. Use this before creating a separate detail page.
